findings.name: Remote PHP Inclusion Enabled
findings.reason: PHP allows URL-aware include and require operations, increasing remote file inclusion impact.

remediations.title: Disable URL includes.
remediations.guidance: Set allow_url_include = Off. Keep include/require targets server-owned and allowlisted.

findings.name: Unrestricted File Upload
findings.reason: An upload is accepted using the client-declared MIME type instead of verified file content.

remediations.title: Verify file content and generate the destination name.
remediations.guidance: Inspect bytes with finfo/Fileinfo, decode the expected image format, enforce size and dimensions, generate a random server-side name, and store outside executable paths.

test_vectors: Upload benign text named `vulcscan-probe.php.jpg` while declaring `Content-Type: image/jpeg`; the server must reject it after inspecting the bytes.

findings.name: Cleartext Password Storage
findings.reason: A password is seeded or stored as cleartext instead of a salted password hash.

remediations.title: Store only salted password hashes.
remediations.guidance: Use password_hash with PASSWORD_ARGON2ID or PASSWORD_DEFAULT and verify with password_verify. Rotate seeded credentials.

findings.name: Hardcoded Credential
findings.reason: A credential-like literal is assigned to a credential name.

remediations.title: Move the credential out of source control and rotate it.
remediations.guidance: Read it from the environment or a secret manager at runtime; treat the committed value as exposed.

findings.name: OS Command Injection
findings.reason: Untrusted input reaches a command interpreter or selects the executed program. The engine traced the value through variables without type or control-flow information.

remediations.title: Run the program without a shell and pass arguments as a list.
remediations.guidance: Select the executable in trusted code and pass every user value as its own argument. Python: subprocess.run([program, arg, value]); Node.js: execFile(program, [arg, value]).

remediations.title: Validate the value against a strict allowlist at the input boundary.
remediations.guidance: Accept only the finite set of identifiers or the character class the operation needs, and reject everything else before the sink.

test_vectors: Append `; printf VULCSCAN_PROBE` to a text parameter on a disposable test instance; success means shell metacharacters were interpreted.

findings.name: Path Traversal
findings.reason: Untrusted input reaches a filesystem path without a verified containment check. The engine traced the value through variables without type or control-flow information.

remediations.title: Resolve the path and enforce base-directory containment.
remediations.guidance: Canonicalize base and candidate (realpath/resolve), then reject the request unless the candidate stays inside the base directory.

remediations.title: Reduce the input to a bare file name.
remediations.guidance: Use basename/secure_filename when the caller only needs to pick a file inside one directory.

test_vectors: Try `../../../../etc/hostname` on Linux or `..\..\..\..\Windows\win.ini` on Windows in an isolated test deployment.
For uploads, use the harmless name `../vulcscan-probe.txt` and benign text content; verify containment and rejection.

findings.name: Server-Side Request Forgery

flow.description: Value reaches PHP URL stream wrapper.

findings.reason: Untrusted input controls the scheme or host of an outbound request. The engine traced the value through variables without type or control-flow information.

remediations.title: Allowlist outbound destinations.
remediations.guidance: Parse the URL, require an allowed scheme and an exact allowlisted host, and build the request from the validated parts.

remediations.title: Fix the host in code and let input select only a path segment.
remediations.guidance: Build the URL from a constant base such as https://api.example.com/ and URL-encode the user value.

test_vectors: Start a controlled local listener, then submit `http://127.0.0.1:8000/vulcscan-probe`; any received request confirms server-side fetching.
Also test alternate loopback spelling such as `http://2130706433:8000/vulcscan-probe` against the same controlled listener.

findings.name: SQL Injection

flow.code: $sql = "SELECT * FROM admin_users WHERE username='" . $u . "' AND password='" . $p . "'"

findings.reason: Untrusted input becomes part of SQL text instead of a bound parameter. The engine traced the value through variables without type or control-flow information.

remediations.title: Replace the raw mysqli query with a prepared statement.
remediations.guidance: Substitute the real constant SQL, bind types and variables shown by the source-to-sink flow. Review the result before applying.

remediations.title: Bind user values as query parameters.
remediations.guidance: Keep the SQL text constant and pass values through the driver's parameter argument. Identifiers such as column names need an allowlist because drivers cannot bind them.

remediations.title: Use the ORM query API instead of raw SQL text.
remediations.guidance: Express the filter with the ORM so values are bound by the library.

test_vectors: Use `' OR '1'='1' -- ` in the reported parameter with test data; compare the result with a normal invalid value.
Use a single quote `'` and confirm the application neither changes query behavior nor exposes a database error.

findings.name: Potential Cross-Site Scripting
findings.reason: Dynamic PHP output reaches an HTML response without contextual output encoding.

remediations.title: Encode dynamic values for their HTML context.
remediations.guidance: Use htmlspecialchars(value, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_SUBSTITUTE, 'UTF-8') for HTML text and attributes. Keep raw HTML out of stored user content.

test_vectors: Submit `` as the reported field on a disposable account, then view the affected page in a test browser.

findings.name: Non-Atomic Check-Then-Update
findings.evidence: UPDATE coupon SET usi_rimanenti = usi_rimanenti - 1 WHERE codice = ?");
findings.reason: A database value is checked and later decremented without an atomic predicate or transaction lock.

remediations.title: Make the state transition atomic.
remediations.guidance: Use one conditional UPDATE such as UPDATE ... SET remaining = remaining - 1 WHERE ... AND remaining > 0, then require exactly one affected row. Use a transaction and row lock when several writes must commit together.
remediations.current: UPDATE coupon SET usi_rimanenti = usi_rimanenti - 1 WHERE codice = ?");

test_vectors: Send two simultaneous requests using one disposable single-use coupon or token; exactly one must succeed and the stored counter must not become negative.

findings.name: Weak Password Hash
findings.reason: Password data goes through a fast general-purpose digest instead of a password hash.

remediations.title: Store passwords with a password hashing function.
remediations.guidance: Use Argon2id, scrypt, bcrypt or PBKDF2 with a per-user salt; rehash on next login.

findings.name: Session Identifier Not Rotated After Login
findings.reason: Authentication state is stored in the session without regenerating its identifier.

remediations.title: Rotate the session identifier after authentication.
remediations.guidance: Call session_regenerate_id(true) immediately after credential verification and before setting authenticated session state.

test_vectors: Record a disposable test session ID before login and confirm that a different ID is issued immediately after successful authentication.

findings.name: Debug Mode Enabled
findings.reason: The configuration enables framework debug behavior.

remediations.title: Disable debug mode outside development.
remediations.guidance: Read the flag from configuration that defaults to false in deployed environments.

findings.name: Missing CSRF Protection
findings.evidence: move_uploaded_file($_FILES['immagine']['tmp_name'], $dest_dir . $nome);         echo "<div class='notice ok'>Immagine caricata: <a href='/img/prodotti/" . htmlspecialchars($nome) .
findings.reason: A PHP POST handler changes state without an apparent anti-CSRF token check.

remediations.title: Require a session-bound anti-CSRF token.
remediations.guidance: Generate a cryptographically random token, store it in the session, include it in the form, and compare it with hash_equals before changing state. Use SameSite cookies as defense in depth.
